name: The Grand Horizon Convention Centre
address: 123 Ocean Drive, Dona Paula, Goa 403004, India

car.title: Driving Directions
details: From Panjim: Head south on NH66, take the Dona Paula exit. Follow signs for 'The Grand Horizon'.
From Airport (GOI): Approximately 45 mins drive via NH366 and NH66.
Complimentary parking is available on-site for all attendees.

train.title: By Train
details: Madgaon Junction (MAO) - 35 km, offers wider connectivity.
Pre-paid taxis and app-based ride services are available from both stations.

bus.title: By Public Bus
details: Frequent bus services connect Panjim KTC Bus Stand to Dona Paula circle.
The venue is a short 5-minute walk from the 'Dona Paula Jetty' bus stop.
